# Andrew's Copy & Print Centre

> Copy and print centre in the heart of downtown Collingwood, Ontario, Canada, with easy access and free parking, serving Collingwood and the surrounding areas since October 1st, 2009. Printing, photocopying and design services with quick turnarounds and competitive pricing. Also a FedEx & Purolator missed delivery & drop-off location.

## Contact

- Phone: 705 446 1114
- Email: andrewscopy@gmail.com

- Hours: Monday to Friday 8:30am - 5:30pm; Saturday 9:00am - 4:00pm; closed Sundays and stat holidays

## About

- Owner/operator: Andrew Heidman.
- Motto: "When you look good, we look good!"

## Services

- Digital printing and B&W or colour copies
- Wide format copying, posters and banners
- Business cards, flyers, brochures, postcards and rack cards
- Graphic design
- Binding (bindery) and laminating
- Labels and die-cut stickers
- Invitations, event tickets, greeting cards and programmes
- Custom envelopes, door hangers and magnets
- Fax service (local, long distance and overseas)
- Wide format: black and white up to 36" wide, colour up to 24" wide (architectural drawings and posters); scan to TIFF or PDF
- Roll lamination up to 24" wide for posters, maps and other large documents
- Scanning to email or USB drive, and photo scanning
- Folding, hand collating and stapling
- Numbered tickets at no extra cost
- Logo design, layout and typesetting
- Photo and logo shirts, custom mousepads, ceramic photo mugs and calendars
- Stationery and office supplies
- Print from email
- Quantity discounts; matches local competitors' pricing
- FedEx & Purolator missed delivery & drop-off location: ship or drop off pre-labeled Canadian & international packages; manual waybills are available

## Sending print files

- Files are sent with WeTransfer (up to 2 GB free) to andrewscopy@gmail.com.
- PDF is preferred, exported with the Press Quality setting (or similar high resolution setting), trim marks on and 1/8" bleed.
- Files should be CMYK with fonts converted to outlines or curves. Files without bleed are fine if text and images are kept away from the edges.
